thinking_text:
**Clarifying feature organization**

I need to ensure I have distinct features within the section. It makes sense to put a single composite feature per solid while naming and describing all distinct functional features. I’m thinking that using "features" in the plural isn’t required; maybe two to four would be better. I'll partition the ranges, even if they’re not perfect. I can name a single feature "integrated ... features," detailing its role and face range.

part.name: Exploded modular 3D-printer hotend and extruder hardware assembly

part_functions.name: Filament melting and deposition
part_functions.function: Guides filament through a heat-break and heated block to a replaceable nozzle, where it is melted and extruded.

part_functions.name: Thermal management
part_functions.function: Uses a finned heat sink and heat-break geometry to limit upward heat conduction and protect the filament feed region.

part_functions.name: Modular mounting
part_functions.function: Provides threaded, counterbored and through-hole interfaces for securing the hotend, heater components and associated brackets.

part_functions.name: Serviceable flow-path interfaces
part_functions.function: Provides multiple threaded nozzle and tube interfaces that can be assembled, retained and replaced independently.

section_functions.name: Hotend support
section_functions.function: The large left-side machined body supports and aligns feed-path hardware through a pattern of axial bores while transferring load to mounting screws.

section_functions.name: Port retention
section_functions.function: Threaded side ports and stepped bores retain fittings or fasteners and maintain coaxial alignment with the internal passages.

feature_functions.name: Structural support
feature_functions.function: Forms the continuous outer shell, mounting shoulders and tapered lower profile that support the surrounding ports.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive face-ID groups forming the adjacent outer walls, top and bottom lands, chamfered perimeter and local port shoulders.

feature_functions.name: Fastener retention
feature_functions.function: Receives screws or fittings from the side and front directions; modeled helical surfaces provide positive axial retention.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive adjacent thread-flank, root, crest, runout and end faces belonging to the manifold's small threaded ports.

feature_functions.name: Coaxial alignment
feature_functions.function: Locates cylindrical feed components and mounting hardware through stepped cylindrical, counterbored and conical lead-in surfaces.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive bore-wall, counterbore-seat, countersink, transition-cone and bore-bottom faces, ordered by the report's connected bore groups.

section_functions.name: Heat rejection
section_functions.function: The large right-side body conducts heat away from the feed path and exposes repeated fins to increase convective surface area.

section_functions.name: Hotend registration
section_functions.function: Large stepped bores and smaller threaded holes locate the heat-break, fittings and mounting screws relative to the heat sink.

feature_functions.name: Attachment
feature_functions.function: Retains fittings and mounting screws on the top, side and end faces of the heat-sink block.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive thread flanks, roots, crests, runouts and small port end faces for the heat-sink fastening interfaces.

feature_functions.name: Cooling and reinforcement
feature_functions.function: The solid spine carries assembly loads while the repeated parallel fins increase area and remain structurally tied to the spine.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive exterior block faces followed by the physically repeated fin top, bottom, root and end faces.

feature_functions.name: Heat-break location
feature_functions.function: Concentric cylindrical and conical surfaces register the heat-break or feed tube and provide shoulders for axial seating.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive stepped cylindrical passages, counterbores, lead-in cones and annular seating faces through the heat-sink body.

section_functions.name: Mechanical clamping
section_functions.function: The forked and slotted body clamps around a cylindrical hotend component while allowing tightening through transverse fasteners.

section_functions.name: Mounting transfer
section_functions.function: Counterbored mounting holes transfer hotend loads into a carriage or supporting frame.

feature_functions.name: Bracket retention
feature_functions.function: Receives mounting and clamp screws; paired holes provide approximately symmetric load transfer around the bracket centerline.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive detailed thread, counterbore, cylindrical wall and local seating faces for the bracket fasteners.

feature_functions.name: Support and load distribution
feature_functions.function: The broad plate, angled lower walls and fork arms support the clamp bore and distribute screw loads across the bracket.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive connected exterior plate, fork, angled flank, end-wall, chamfer and broad mounting-surface faces.

features.name: Central cylindrical clamp bore and relief slot

feature_functions.name: Compliant clamping
feature_functions.function: The circular opening registers the cylindrical component while the adjoining slot lets the fork arms deflect under screw preload.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive clamp-bore wall, lead-in transition, annular end faces and the adjacent longitudinal relief passage.

section_functions.name: Thermal isolation
section_functions.function: The narrow tubular member connects hot and cold components while limiting the conductive cross-section.

section_functions.name: Filament guidance
section_functions.function: Its coaxial internal passage guides filament toward the melt zone with minimal lateral displacement.

features.name: Outer throat, threaded end and collars

feature_functions.name: Axial connection
feature_functions.function: External cylindrical and threaded surfaces screw into or register against adjacent hotend bodies; shoulders set insertion depth.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive outer tube, reduced neck, threaded-end, collar, shoulder and transition-cone faces in axial adjacency order.

feature_functions.name: Material guidance
feature_functions.function: Maintains a continuous axial channel through the heat-break and provides entry and exit lead-ins.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive inner passage, end annuli, bore transitions and local opening faces.

section_functions.name: Component capture
section_functions.function: The compact slotted block captures a cylindrical tube or heater component and uses threaded ports to apply retaining force.

section_functions.name: Flow-path support
section_functions.function: A larger coaxial opening supports passage of the heat-break or feed element while adjacent holes provide fastening.

feature_functions.name: Retention
feature_functions.function: Detailed internal threads retain fittings or screws and resist axial separation from the block.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive adjacent thread-flank, crest, root, runout and opening faces for the block's threaded interfaces.

features.name: Large cylindrical bore and clamp opening

feature_functions.name: Registration and clamping
feature_functions.function: Locates the cylindrical hotend element and permits local deflection through the connected slot.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive lead-in cones, cylindrical bore walls and annular end faces of the primary block openings.

feature_functions.name: Structural enclosure
feature_functions.function: Connects all ports and forms the split arm, end walls and planar mounting surfaces around the bore.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive outer rectangular faces, corner chamfers, split-slot walls and remaining local transition surfaces.

section_functions.name: Melt-zone formation
section_functions.function: The metal block surrounds the nozzle and heat-break interfaces and distributes heater energy around the filament flow path.

section_functions.name: Heater and sensor retention
section_functions.function: Transverse bores and clamp features retain a heater cartridge, temperature sensor and securing screws.

features.name: Threaded nozzle, heat-break and clamp ports

feature_functions.name: Sealed mechanical connection
feature_functions.function: Threads retain nozzle and tube components under thermal cycling and provide preload at mating shoulders.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive detailed helical thread surfaces, runouts and opening faces for the block's axial and transverse threaded ports.

feature_functions.name: Thermal input and sensing
feature_functions.function: Cylindrical bores position heating and sensing elements close to the melt path while smaller screw interfaces retain them.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive bore walls, conical lead-ins, counterbore seats and end annuli of the cartridge and sensor interfaces.

features.name: Machined heater-block shell and clamp relief

feature_functions.name: Heat spreading and support
feature_functions.function: The compact continuous body conducts heat between interfaces, supports the nozzle axis and incorporates relief geometry for clamping.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive exterior walls, chamfered corners, clamp-slot faces, shoulders and remaining connected support surfaces.

section_functions.name: Short-range extrusion
section_functions.function: A compact threaded nozzle screws into a heater block and constricts molten material to a small outlet.

feature_functions.name: Nozzle retention
feature_functions.function: Provides removable threaded engagement and axial preload against the heater-block seat.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive thread crest, root, flank, runout and cylindrical transition faces arranged along the nozzle axis.

feature_functions.name: Torque transmission
feature_functions.function: Six planar flats accept a wrench and transmit installation torque into the threaded stem.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive six connected hex flats, upper and lower chamfers, and adjacent annular shoulder faces.

feature_functions.name: Flow convergence
feature_functions.function: The internal passage and tapered tip accelerate and shape molten polymer into the final extrudate.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive conical tip, outlet bore, internal axial passage and adjacent terminal annular surfaces.

section_functions.name: Intermediate-reach extrusion
section_functions.function: Provides a longer threaded and flow-path configuration for an alternative heater-block stack-up.

feature_functions.name: Nozzle retention
feature_functions.function: Engages the mating heater-block thread and establishes axial sealing preload.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive adjacent thread flanks, roots, crests, runouts and stem transition faces.

feature_functions.name: Installation torque
feature_functions.function: Provides opposed wrench flats and chamfered edges for controlled assembly and removal.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive connected hex flats, edge chamfers, shoulder faces and nearby short cylindrical transitions.

features.name: Extended tip and internal flow path

feature_functions.name: Extrudate shaping
feature_functions.function: Converges molten material through a coaxial passage and discharges it through the terminal orifice.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive tip, outlet, internal bore, terminal annuli and the small rounded transition at the orifice.

section_functions.name: Long-reach extrusion
section_functions.function: Provides the longest threaded stem and flow passage among the three nozzle variants for a deeper heater-block or stand-off configuration.

feature_functions.name: Deep threaded engagement
feature_functions.function: Provides extended engagement length for retention, alignment and heat transfer into the mating block.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive sequential thread-flank, root, crest, runout and cylindrical stem faces along the long nozzle axis.

feature_functions.name: Torque and axial seating
feature_functions.function: The symmetric hex flats transmit wrench torque while the adjacent shoulder establishes the assembled axial position.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive six connected wrench flats, corner transitions, chamfers and annular seating faces.

features.name: Long conical tip and extrusion bore

feature_functions.name: Controlled material discharge
feature_functions.function: The elongated coaxial passage feeds a tapered outlet that defines final extrusion diameter and direction.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Inclusive tapered tip, outlet bore, long internal passage, terminal annuli and local transition surfaces.
